text:
ashley: Heads-up — saw a short burst of 504s hitting /v1/generate and /v1/chat around 03:04–03:10 UTC. Spike peaked ~1.2% error rate for ~6m. Any quick places to look for traces and whether we should quiet the alert?

raj: Start with the ingress 504 heatmap in Grafana and the gateway logs in Kibana. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress/errors?panel=504 . Kibana: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#/?q=504 . If it's proxy timeouts look for upstream latency + `502 -> 504` sequence.

marta: Also check the LB -> edge-nginx logs for `upstream timed out`. I pulled one sample trace: trace_id=1a2b3c4d showing repeated `proxy_send_timeout` on pod inference-3. I'll paste the curl to fetch trace: `curl -H 'x-trace-id:1a2b3c4d' https://trace.redwood.internal/1a2b3c4d`

deploy-bot: Alert `ingress_504_rate` fired at 2026-03-15T03:05:12Z for service=ingress edge-lb (rate 1.15%).

sre-oncall: :eyes: Oncall grabbing dash + traces now. Quick triage checklist: 1) check ingress and backend pod cpu/mem around window 2) look for connection resets in kernel logs 3) check kvcache prefix eviction (if inference pods hit heavy cache misses) 4) check LB circuit-breaker counts.

raj: I see a tight cluster of 504s correlated with increased tail latency on inference pods — pods had CPU steal for a few seconds. Also noticed kube-proxy retransmits. Sampling more traces now.

ashley: thanks. I'm going to quiet the alert for 15m (proposal: debounce from 1m to 5m for this rule) while we gather evidence. Can someone attach a few example request ids so I can file a followup? :white_check_mark:

marta: attaching three request ids: req_20260315_1a, req_20260315_2b, req_20260315_3c. One trace shows `proxy_write_timeout` at edge, backend returned 200 but after the client's timeout.

raj: proposing short-term mitigation: increase `proxy_read_timeout` on ingress to 90s for inference routes and set canary for 30m. Long-term: investigate kernel tuning + burst scaling. I'll open an RFC and assign to inference infra.

ashley: perfect. if raj can open RFC and drop links here I'll close this thread. Assigning followup to @raj. :thumbsup:
